{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_id values
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check how many duplicates exist
duplicate_count = len(df) - unique_patients

print(f'Unique patient IDs: {unique_patients}')
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs (total rows - unique): {duplicate_count}')"}
